90S LUXURY COUPE:
TOYOTA SOARER (JZZ30)

Twin-turbo 1JZ-GTE heritage and sleek aerodynamic grand-touring lines—Toyota’s iconic JDM flagship coupe in Liquid Silver Metallic.

CHASSIS: TOYOTA SOARER JZZ30  |  SPEC: METAL/METAL + REAL RIDERS  |  STATUS: FACTORY SEALED

Recreating Japan’s premier 1990s personal luxury grand tourer, the Hot Wheels Premium Car Culture: Modern Classics Toyota Soarer (JZZ30) brings the legendary JDM sibling of the Lexus SC300/SC400 to 1:64 scale[cite: 1]. Finished in sleek Silver Metallic with crisp badging, clean body lines, and period-correct stance, this casting is a must-have for 1990s Japanese street-car collectors[cite: 1].

1JZ-GTE HERITAGE • JDM MODERN CLASSICS
THE ENGINEERING

Full Metal/Metal & Real Riders

Built to full Hot Wheels Car Culture specifications with a heavyweight diecast metal body and solid metal chassis, fitted with soft treaded Real Riders rubber tires on classic multi-spoke silver racing wheels[cite: 1].

THE PROVENANCE

Curated From The BLKHDZ Vault

Stored untouched in our climate-controlled Tampa facility since arrival from sealed distributor cases[cite: 1]. Dispatched inside a rigid corrugated cardboard box with heavy bubble protection—never a soft mailer—to protect card corners and blister integrity[cite: 1].

“True collecting isn’t about volume—it’s about provenance, sharp edges, and preserving iconic castings exactly as they left the factory floor.”

2023 24 HOURS OF LE MANS • GARAGE 56

CHEVROLET CAMARO ZL1 #24:
POST-RACE WEATHERED EDITION

Hendrick Motorsports’ historic NASCAR Next Gen endurance entry—captured in battle-scarred Le Mans finish by TopSpeed 1:18.

CHASSIS: NEXT GEN ZL1 #24  |  STUDIO: TOPSPEED TS0561  |  STATUS: FACTORY SEALED (NIB)

When Hendrick Motorsports brought American V8 stock-car thunder to Circuit de la Sarthe for the 2023 24 Hours of Le Mans Centenary, the No. 24 Garage 56 Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 captivated motorsport fans worldwide. Piloted by seven-time NASCAR champion Jimmie Johnson, F1 World Champion Jenson Button, and Le Mans winner Mike Rockenfeller, the modified Next Gen racer conquered 285 grueling laps—and this TopSpeed 1:18 specimen preserves every ounce of its post-race grit.

THE ENGINEERING

Authentic 24-Hour Battle Scars

Hand-finished by TopSpeed to replicate the exact checkered-flag condition at Le Mans, featuring realistic track grime, rubber marbling, endurance headlight clusters, dive planes, carbon rear wing, and Goodyear Eagle racing slicks.

THE PROVENANCE

Curated From The BLKHDZ Vault

Sourced directly from authorized US distributor allocation and housed in our climate-controlled Tampa vault. The outer box was opened strictly for inspection; the model remains 100% factory-sealed inside its original clear protective wrap. Ships exclusively in a rigid corrugated box with heavy perimeter protection—never a mailer.

“True collecting isn’t about volume—it’s about provenance, sharp edges, and preserving motorsport history exactly as it left the factory floor.”

— THE BLKHDZ STANDARD • ARCHIVAL GRADE • VETERAN OWNED

itemSummaries.title: LEGO 10355 Blacktron Renegade Retired Sealed + 2 V.1 Figs + Sealed Mutant CMF
itemSummaries.description:
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="light only">
<title>LEGO Icons 10355 Blacktron Renegade Retired + 3 Extra Blacktron Minifigures - BLKHDZ LLC</title>

<div class="blkhdz-mecha-chassis">
<style>
    @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Chakra+Petch:ital,wght@0,600;0,700;1,700&family=Share+Tech+Mono&family=Inter:wght@400;600;800&display=swap');

    :root {
        color-scheme: light only;
        --bt-yellow-deep: #ca8a04;     /* Deep Industrial Gold */
        --bt-yellow: #eab308;          /* Primary Blacktron Yellow */
        --bt-yellow-bright: #ffd400;   /* High-Vis Blacktron Yellow */
        --bt-yellow-glow: #fef08a;     /* Highlight Yellow */
        --bt-gray-outline: #52525b;    /* Crisp Gray Kanji Outline */
        --bt-void: #070709;            /* Deep Space Black */
        --bt-carbon: #0d0e12;          /* Tactical Carbon Black */
    }

    .blkhdz-mecha-chassis, .blkhdz-mecha-chassis * {
        box-sizing: border-box !important;
        max-width: 100% !important;
    }

    .blkhdz-mecha-chassis {
        background-color: #18181b !important;
        padding: 18px 12px;
        margin: 0;
        font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
        color: #09090b !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: #09090b !important;
        line-height: 1.6;
        -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
    }

    .blkhdz-mecha-grid {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: row;
        max-width: 1120px;
        margin: 0 auto;
        gap: 22px;
        align-items: flex-start;
    }

    /* LEFT MARGIN: BLKHDZ VAULT DIRECTORY */
    .blkhdz-vault-terminal {
        width: 238px;
        background-color: var(--bt-carbon) !important;
        border: 2px solid #09090b !important;
        border-top: 5px solid var(--bt-yellow-bright) !important;
        padding: 18px 13px;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        box-shadow: 6px 6px 0px #000000;
    }

    .blkhdz-term-code {
        font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
        font-size: 10px;
        letter-spacing: 2px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--bt-yellow-bright) !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--bt-yellow-bright) !important;
        text-align: center;
        margin-bottom: 2px;
    }

    .blkhdz-term-head {
        font-family: 'Chakra Petch', 'Arial Black', sans-serif;
        font-size: 18px;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 1.5px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: #ffffff !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: #ffffff !important;
        text-align: center;
        padding-bottom: 10px;
        margin-bottom: 12px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #3f3f46 !important;
    }

    .blkhdz-term-list {
        list-style: none;
        padding: 0;
        margin: 0;
    }

    .blkhdz-term-list li {
        border-bottom: 1px solid #27272a !important;
    }

    .blkhdz-term-list li:last-child {
        border-bottom: none !important;
    }

    .blkhdz-term-list a {
        display: block;
        padding: 8px 6px;
        font-family: 'Chakra Petch', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
        font-size: 11px;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.9px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: #f4f4f5 !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: #f4f4f5 !important;
        text-decoration: none;
        border-left: 3px solid transparent;
        transition: all 0.15s ease;
    }

    .blkhdz-term-list a:hover {
        background-color: #27272a !important;
        border-left-color: var(--bt-yellow-bright) !important;
        padding-left: 10px;
        color: var(--bt-yellow-bright) !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--bt-yellow-bright) !important;
    }

    /* RIGHT COLUMN: MAIN SPEC UNIT + CLOSING FOOTER */
    .blkhdz-mecha-main {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        flex-grow: 1;
        background-color: #ffffff !important;
        border: 2px solid #09090b !important;
        box-shadow: 8px 8px 0px #000000;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    .blkhdz-mecha-body-wrap {
        background-color: #ffffff !important;
    }

    /* TOP HARDWARE TELEMETRY STRIP */
    .blkhdz-top-telemetry {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        padding: 9px 20px;
        background-color: var(--bt-carbon) !important;
        border-bottom: 3px solid var(--bt-yellow-bright) !important;
        font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
        font-size: 10.5px;
        letter-spacing: 1.5px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: #e4e4e7 !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: #e4e4e7 !important;
    }

    .blkhdz-top-telemetry span b {
        color: var(--bt-yellow-bright) !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--bt-yellow-bright) !important;
    }

    /* HERO + UPPER DESCRIPTION SPLIT WITH TALL VERTICAL KANJI SPINE (~0.5 LISTING LENGTH) */
    .blkhdz-mecha-hero {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: row;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: stretch;
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #070709 0%, #141419 68%, #292205 100%) !important;
        border-bottom: 2px solid #09090b !important;
        min-height: 460px;
    }

    .blkhdz-hero-content {
        padding: 32px 24px 28px 26px;
        flex-grow: 1;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .blkhdz-spec-pill {
        display: inline-block;
        align-self: flex-start;
        background-color: var(--bt-yellow-bright) !important;
        color: #09090b !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: #09090b !important;
        font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
        font-size: 11px;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 2px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        padding: 4px 10px;
        margin-bottom: 14px;
        border-left: 4px solid #ffffff !important;
    }

    .blkhdz-mecha-title {
        margin: 0;
        font-family: 'Chakra Petch', 'Arial Black', sans-serif;
        font-size: clamp(26px, 4.4vw, 42px);
        font-weight: 700;
        line-height: 1.04;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        color: #ffffff !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: #ffffff !important;
    }

    .blkhdz-mecha-title span {
        color: var(--bt-yellow-bright) !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--bt-yellow-bright) !important;
    }

    .blkhdz-mecha-sub {
        margin: 12px 0 0 0;
        font-size: 14.5px;
        line-height: 1.55;
        color: #f4f4f5 !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: #f4f4f5 !important;
        max-width: 580px;
    }

    .blkhdz-mecha-sub strong {
        color: var(--bt-yellow-bright) !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--bt-yellow-bright) !important;
    }

    .blkhdz-serial-row {
        margin-top: 20px;
        padding-top: 12px;
        border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 212, 0, 0.35) !important;
        font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
        font-size: 11px;
        letter-spacing: 1.4px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--bt-yellow-bright) !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--bt-yellow-bright) !important;
    }

    .blkhdz-serial-row b {
        color: #ffffff !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: #ffffff !important;
    }

    /* RIGHT-EDGE VERTICAL INDUSTRIAL STENCIL SPINE (GRAY-OUTLINED KANJI) */
    .blkhdz-stencil-spine {
        width: 128px;
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bt-yellow-bright) 0%, var(--bt-yellow-deep) 100%) !important;
        border-left: 2px solid #ffffff !important;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        padding: 18px 8px;
        flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .blkhdz-kanji-stack {
        font-family: 'Chakra Petch', 'Meiryo', 'Yu Gothic', sans-serif;
        font-weight: 900;
        font-size: clamp(32px, 3.8vw, 44px);
        line-height: 1.24;
        color: #09090b !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: #09090b !important;
        -webkit-text-stroke: 1.25px #71717a;
        text-shadow: 1px 1px 0px #52525b, -1px -1px 0px #52525b, 0 0 2px #52525b;
        text-align: center;
        letter-spacing: 1px;
        user-select: none;
    }

    .blkhdz-kanji-accent {
        display: inline-block;
        background-color: #09090b !important;
        color: #ffffff !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: #ffffff !important;
        -webkit-text-stroke: 1px #a1a1aa;
        text-shadow: 1px 1px 0px #71717a, -1px -1px 0px #71717a;
        padding: 2px 10px;
        margin: 5px 0;
        font-size: clamp(28px, 3.4vw, 39px);
        border: 2px solid #a1a1aa !important;
    }

    .blkhdz-spine-code {
        margin-top: 12px;
        width: 100%;
        background-color: #09090b !important;
        color: var(--bt-yellow-bright) !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--bt-yellow-bright) !important;
        font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 11px;
        letter-spacing: 1px;
        text-align: center;
        padding: 4px 2px;
        border: 1px solid #71717a !important;
    }

    /* ARTICLE / SPEC INTERIOR */
    .blkhdz-spec-interior {
        padding: 26px 26px 24px 26px;
        background-color: #ffffff !important;
    }

    .blkhdz-vault-notice {
        background-color: #fefce8 !important;
        border: 1px solid #fde047 !important;
        border-left: 5px solid #09090b !important;
        padding: 14px 18px;
        margin-bottom: 22px;
        font-size: 13px;
        color: #09090b !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: #09090b !important;
    }

    .blkhdz-notice-tag {
        display: block;
        font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
        font-size: 11px;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 2px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: #854d0e !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: #854d0e !important;
        margin-bottom: 3px;
    }

    /* 4-UNIT HARDWARE METRICS WITH BLACK / YELLOW / WHITE TOP ACCENTS */
    .blkhdz-unit-metrics {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
        border: 2px solid #09090b !important;
        background-color: #fafafa !important;
        margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .blkhdz-unit-cell {
        padding: 12px 8px;
        text-align: center;
        border-right: 1px solid #d4d4d8 !important;
        border-top: 4px solid #09090b !important;
    }

    .blkhdz-unit-cell:nth-child(2) {
        border-top-color: var(--bt-yellow-bright) !important;
    }

    .blkhdz-unit-cell:nth-child(3) {
        border-top-color: #09090b !important;
    }

    .blkhdz-unit-cell:nth-child(4) {
        border-top-color: var(--bt-yellow-bright) !important;
    }

    .blkhdz-unit-cell:last-child {
        border-right: none !important;
    }

    .blkhdz-unit-val {
        display: block;
        font-family: 'Chakra Petch', 'Arial Black', sans-serif;
        font-size: 22px;
        font-weight: 700;
        line-height: 1.1;
        color: #09090b !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: #09090b !important;
    }

    .blkhdz-unit-lbl {
        display: block;
        margin-top: 3px;
        font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
        font-size: 9.5px;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 1.2px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: #713f12 !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: #713f12 !important;
    }

    /* TWO-COLUMN MODULAR ARMOR CARDS */
    .blkhdz-module-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        gap: 20px;
        margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .blkhdz-module-card {
        background-color: #fafafa !important;
        border: 1px solid #d4d4d8 !important;
        border-top: 4px solid #09090b !important;
        padding: 16px 16px 14px 16px;
    }

    .blkhdz-module-card.yellow-mod {
        border-top-color: var(--bt-yellow-bright) !important;
        background-color: #fefce8 !important;
    }

    .blkhdz-mod-code {
        font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
        font-size: 10px;
        letter-spacing: 1.8px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: #854d0e !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: #854d0e !important;
        margin-bottom: 3px;
    }

    .blkhdz-mod-title {
        font-family: 'Chakra Petch', 'Arial Black', sans-serif;
        font-size: 17px;
        font-weight: 700;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: #09090b !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: #09090b !important;
        margin: 0 0 8px 0;
    }

    .blkhdz-module-card p {
        margin: 0;
        font-size: 13.5px;
        line-height: 1.55;
        color: #18181b !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: #18181b !important;
    }

    /* TECHNICAL MANIFEST TABLE */
    .blkhdz-manifest-bar {
        font-family: 'Chakra Petch', 'Arial Black', sans-serif;
        font-size: 16px;
        font-weight: 700;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 1.2px;
        color: #09090b !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: #09090b !important;
        border-bottom: 2px solid var(--bt-yellow-bright) !important;
        padding-bottom: 6px;
        margin-bottom: 10px;
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: baseline;
    }

    .blkhdz-manifest-bar span {
        font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
        font-size: 10.5px;
        color: #713f12 !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: #713f12 !important;
    }

    .blkhdz-manifest-table {
        width: 100%;
        border-collapse: collapse;
        font-size: 12.5px;
    }

    .blkhdz-manifest-table td {
        padding: 8px 6px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #e4e4e7 !important;
        vertical-align: top;
    }

    .blkhdz-manifest-table td:first-child {
        width: 34%;
        font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
        font-weight: 700;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.8px;
        color: #09090b !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: #09090b !important;
        font-size: 11.5px;
    }

    .blkhdz-manifest-table td:last-child {
        color: #18181b !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: #18181b !important;
        font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* TACTICAL BARCODE & CTA FOOTER */
    .blkhdz-mecha-footer {
        background-color: var(--bt-carbon) !important;
        border-top: 3px solid var(--bt-yellow-bright) !important;
        padding: 24px 22px;
        text-align: center;
    }

    .blkhdz-barcode-strip {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        border: 1px solid #3f3f46 !important;
        background-color: #18181b !important;
        padding: 8px 14px;
        margin-bottom: 20px;
        font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
        font-size: 10px;
        letter-spacing: 1.5px;
        color: var(--bt-yellow-bright) !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--bt-yellow-bright) !important;
    }

    .blkhdz-barcode-bars {
        height: 16px;
        width: 110px;
        background: repeating-linear-gradient(
            90deg,
            #ffffff 0px, #ffffff 2px,
            transparent 2px, transparent 4px,
            #ffd400 4px, #ffd400 7px,
            transparent 7px, transparent 9px,
            #ffffff 9px, #ffffff 11px,
            transparent 11px, transparent 14px
        );
    }

    .blkhdz-mecha-cta {
        display: inline-block;
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--bt-yellow) 0%, var(--bt-yellow-bright) 100%) !important;
        color: #09090b !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: #09090b !important;
        font-family: 'Chakra Petch', 'Arial Black', sans-serif;
        font-size: 17px;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 2px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        text-decoration: none;
        padding: 13px 36px;
        border: 2px solid #ffffff !important;
        box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px var(--bt-yellow-bright);
        transition: all 0.15s ease;
    }

    .blkhdz-mecha-cta:hover {
        background: #ffffff !important;
        color: #09090b !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: #09090b !important;
    }

    .blkhdz-mecha-stamp {
        margin-top: 15px;
        font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
        font-size: 10.5px;
        letter-spacing: 3px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: #a1a1aa !important;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: #a1a1aa !important;
    }

    /* MOBILE REFLOW: 1. RENEGADE SPEC -> 2. VAULT LINKS -> 3. CTA FOOTER */
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
        .blkhdz-mecha-chassis { padding: 8px !important; }
        .blkhdz-mecha-grid {
            display: flex !important;
            flex-direction: column !important;
            gap: 14px !important;
        }
        .blkhdz-mecha-main {
            display: contents !important;
        }
        .blkhdz-mecha-body-wrap {
